column12: Your Online Activity.I find it hard to stop scrolling even when I know I should be doing something else.
column13: Your Online Activity.I sometimes post or reply online before I've fully thought through what I want to say.
column14: Online Feelings.When someone is upset online, it rarely affects me emotionally.
column15: Online Feelings.I don't feel as responsible for other people's feelings when I'm communicating online.
column16: Online Feelings.It's easier for me to ignore someone's feelings in an online conversation than in person.
column17: Online Feelings.I feel less emotionally involved in online conflicts than face-to-face arguments.
column18: Online Norms.It's pretty normal for people to be rude or hostile online.
column19: Online Norms.Swearing or insulting others is just part of online culture.
column20: Online Norms.People should expect harsh comments if they post controversial opinions online.
column21: Online Norms.Calling someone names online isn't a big deal compared to saying it in person.
column22: Your Sense of Online Anonymity.When I'm online, I feel like people don't really know who I am.
column23: Your Sense of Online Anonymity.I feel more anonymous online than in face-to-face situations.
column24: Your Sense of Online Anonymity.It would be hard for most people to connect my online activity back to me personally.
column25: Your Sense of Online Anonymity.I feel like I can "blend in" online and not stand out as a specific individual.
column26: Online Reactions.Sometimes people deserve a harsh response online if they say something offensive.
column27: Online Reactions.If someone attacks me online, I feel justified in attacking them back.
column28: Online Reactions.Making fun of someone online is acceptable if they started the argument.
column29: Online Reactions.I can understand why people join in when others gang up on someone online.
column30: Online Reactions.Posting a cutting comment can be a good way to shut down someone who's being annoying.
column31: Online Reactions.I don't feel particularly guilty if I've been harsh to someone online.

column35: Your Trust in AI Tools.I am cautious about AI systems and rarely rely on them.
column36: Your Trust in AI Tools.Overall, I feel AI tools are safe to use.
